url.label: Connection URL
url.description: Connection string, e.g. http://1.2.3.5:8000. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

database.label: Database
database.description: A string indicating the name of the database to connect to.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.description: As string indicating the namespace of the database to connect to.

username.label: Username
username.description: As string indicating the username of the database to connect to.

password.label: Password
password.description: As string indicating the password of the database to connect to.

query.label: Query
query.description: Provide a SurrealDB query string to execute.

args.label: Arguments
args.description: Add all arguments as names here, don't add the $ sign.

query_timeout.label: Query Timeout (ms)
query_timeout.description: The maximum time to wait for a query to complete before timing out.

application_name.label: Application Name
application_name.description: An identifier for the client application executing the query.

surrealdb_list_namespaces.label: List Namespaces
surrealdb_list_namespaces.description: Lists the namespaces on the SurrealDB server.

surrealdb_list_databases.label: List Databases
surrealdb_list_databases.description: Lists the databases in the connection's namespace.

surrealdb_list_tables.label: List Tables
surrealdb_list_tables.description: Lists the tables defined in the connected database.

surrealdb_get_database_info.label: Get Database Info
surrealdb_get_database_info.description: Gets everything defined in the connected database.

surrealdb_describe_table.label: Describe Table
surrealdb_describe_table.description: Gets a table's fields, indexes, events and views.

table.label: Table
table.description: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.

params: IF $table NOTINSIDE (INFO FOR DB STRUCTURE).tables.name { THROW "Table '" + $table + "' does not exist. Use List Tables to see the tables."; }; INFO FOR TABLE $table STRUCTURE;

surrealdb_get_record.label: Get Record
surrealdb_get_record.description: Gets one record by its id.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.

surrealdb_count_records.label: Count Records
surrealdb_count_records.description: Counts the records in a table that match filters.

table.label: Table
table.description: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: JSON object of conditions, all combined with AND. {"field": value} matches equality; {"field": {"$gt": 18}} uses an operator: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $containsNot, $containsAny, $containsAll, $exists (true/false). Nested fields use dots ("address.city"). Wrap a value as {"$record": "user:tobie"}, {"$datetime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"$decimal": "1.50"}, {"$uuid": "..."} or {"$duration": "1h"} to compare against that SurrealDB type; plain strings stay strings.

params: SELECT count() FROM type::table($table) GROUP ALL;

surrealdb_delete_record.label: Delete Record
surrealdb_delete_record.description: Permanently deletes one record by its id.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.

surrealdb_relate_records.label: Relate Records
surrealdb_relate_records.description: Creates a graph edge from one record to another.

fromRecordId.label: From Record ID
fromRecordId.description: Record the edge starts at, in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie".

edge.label: Edge Table
edge.description: Name of the edge table, e.g. "knows" or "purchased". Created if it does not exist.

toRecordId.label: To Record ID
toRecordId.description: Record the edge points to, in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:jaime".

data.label: Data
data.description: Optional JSON object of fields stored on the edge, e.g. {"since": 2020}.

surrealdb_run_function.label: Run Function
surrealdb_run_function.description: Runs a custom or built-in SurrealDB function with arguments.

args.label: Arguments
args.description: JSON array of positional arguments, e.g. ["Tobie", 33]. Leave empty for none.

surrealdb_run_gql_query.label: Run GQL Query
surrealdb_run_gql_query.description: Runs an ISO GQL graph query, e.g. MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.

query.label: GQL Query
query.description: GQL statement, e.g. MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.
